messages:
felix: Quick heads-up 5: spotted a parity/ordering bug in the Java sampleapp where req_id shows up in OTLP spans but some INFO logs after an auth retry are `<redacted>`. Seems tied to a retry that temporarily bumps log level.

rachel: Hmm, which branch and quickstart? tiny logs?

felix: sample-java quickstart (master). Steps: set REDACT=1 LOG_LEVEL=info, run with local OTEL collector, call /login which simulates a 401 then 200 (retry). Minimal snippet:
```
INFO  com.redwood.auth.LoginHandler - start user=zoe req_id=JID-77
DEBUG com.redwood.http.AuthRetry - retry attempt=1
INFO  com.redwood.auth.LoginHandler - success user=zoe req_id=<redacted>
```
OTLP spans exported show attribute req_id=JID-77 for all events. Only the final INFO ended up redacted.

mina: Do we redact by scanning formatted text or using MDC/span attributes? If it's text-only, async exporter ordering or logger wrapping could race.

felix: Our Java redaction filter runs as a java.util.logging Filter that inspects LogRecord.getMessage() before the OpenTelemetry bridge attaches span attributes into MDC. The retry path triggers a log emission timing that wins the race.

mina: Two quick, low-risk fixes: (1) write req_id into MDC/ThreadContext at the very start of the request handler and ensure the span is created with the req_id attribute before any downstream code logs. (2) Reorder initialization so the redaction filter prefers structured attributes (MDC/span attrs) when available instead of regexing the text.

rachel: Agree. For Java sample specifically, adding: `MDC.put("req_id", reqId); Span.current().setAttribute("req_id", reqId);` at handler entry fixed my local repro.

felix: Also note: some teams enable global DEBUG during retry paths which increases event volume and changes scheduling. That's why onboarding quickstart should recommend LOG_LEVEL=info (we can keep debug in an advanced section).

mina: Can we add a cross-SDK note in DX that says: always attach request identifiers to the structured logging context / span attribute early, and make redaction prefer structured data? That will avoid language/runtime traps.

felix: I'll open a PR on sample-java to: attach req_id early, add a tiny integration test that forces 401->200, and add a doc callout in the quickstart.

ops-bot: Created DX-5039: "sample-java: make req_id propagation + redaction deterministic during retry flows" (https://redwood.internal/DX-5039)

rachel: Nice. Mina - can you paste a short snippet for the logger filter change so I can mirror in node/python?

mina: Java filter pseudo: `if (MDC.get("req_id") != null) redactFromStructured(MDC.get("req_id")) else fallbackRegex(record.getMessage())` 5: will add to the PR.

felix: Thanks. I'll also run a quick parity test across node/go/python and paste logs in DX-5039 so we can make a cross-runtime recommendation.

rachel: I'll update quickstart wording to recommend LOG_LEVEL=info for onboarding and link the ticket. :+1:

mina: If anyone hits a different root cause in their runtime, drop snippets in the ticket and we can generalize the fix.

ops-bot: Assigned DX-5039 -> devex team.
